content: Bɑ kɑ woodɑn kpɑkoro te dɑ
Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ

Yen biru, Sɑlomɔɔ u Isirelibɑn ɡuro ɡurobu kɑ ben yɛnu yɛ̃robu kɑ ben bwese kɛrɑ bɑɑyeren wiruɡibu sokusiɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ bu kɑ Yinni Gusunɔn woodɑn kpɑkororu suɑmɑ sɑɑ Dɑfidin sinɑ kpɑɑrun di te bɑ mɔ̀ Siɔni, kpɑ bu tu doke sɑ̃ɑ yeru mi.
Yerɑ Isirelibɑ kpuro bɑ mɛnnɑ Sɑlomɔɔn mi, wɔ̃ɔn suru nɔɔbɑ yiruse wì sɔɔ bɑ rɑ tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑru ɡɑru ko.
Ye ben ɡuro ɡuro be kpuro bɑ tunumɑ, yerɑ yɑ̃ku kowobu bɑ Yinni Gusunɔn woodɑn kpɑkoro te suɑ,
kɑ win kuu bekuruɡii te, kɑ sere sɑ̃ɑrun dendi yɑ̃ɑ ni nu wɑ̃ɑ te sɔɔ kpuro. Yɑ̃ku kowobu Lefibɑrɑ bɑ ye kpuro suɑmɑ.
Sinɑ boko Sɑlomɔɔ kɑ Isirelibɑ kpuro be bɑ mɛnnɛ mi, bɑ nɑ bɑ yɔ̃rɑ Yinni Gusunɔn woodɑn kpɑkoro ten bɔkuɔ. Mɑ bɑ yɑ̃ɑnu kɑ kɛtɛ dɑbinu ɡo bɑ kɑ yɑ̃kunu kuɑ. Sɑbe ni bɑ ɡo mi, nu ǹ ɡɑrirɔ.
Mɑ yɑ̃ku kowobu bɑ kɑ Yinni Gusunɔn woodɑn kpɑkoro te dɑ ten ɑyerɔ dii te tɑ dɛɛre ɡem ɡem sɔɔ. Bɑ tu yiwɑ wɔllun kɔ̃sobun weenɑsibu yirun kɑsin kɔkɔrɔ.
Kɔ̃so be, bɑ kɑsɑ dɛriewɑ bɑ woodɑn kpɑkoro te wukiri.
Bɑ koo kpĩ bu nɛnutiɑ ye wɑ yɑ tere sɑɑ dii te tɑ dɛɛre ɡem ɡem kɔnnɔn di, domi bɑ ye kuɑwɑ yɑ dɛ̃u. Adɑmɑ bɑ ǹ kpɛ̃ bu ye wɑ sɑɑ tɔɔn di. Miyɑ yɑ wɑ̃ɑ sere kɑ ɡisɔn ɡisɔ.
Gɑ̃ɑnu sɑri kpɑkoro te sɔɔ, mɑ n kun mɔ woodɑ wɔkurun kpee bɛsi yiru yi Mɔwisi u doke mi. Yinni Gusunɔwɑ u nùn yi wɛ̃ Horɛbun ɡuurɔ sɑnɑm mɛ u kɑ Isirelibɑ ɑrukɑwɑni bɔkuɑ, ye bɑ yɑrimɑ Eɡibitin di.
Sɑɑ ye yɑ̃ku kowo be, bɑ yɑrimɑ sɑ̃ɑ yee ten min di, yerɑ ɡuru wii wurorɑ dii te wukiri, sere kɑ ten sɔɔwɔ.
Yɑ̃ku kowo be, bɑ kpɑnɑ bu ben sɔmburu ko dii ten mi, ɡuru wii wuro ten sɑɑbu. Domi Yinni Gusunɔn yiiko yɑ yibɑ dii te sɔɔ.
Yerɑ Sɑlomɔɔ u nɔɔɡiru suɑ u nɛɛ,

content.text: Yinni Gusunɔ, ɑ bwisikɑ ɑ n wɑ̃ɑ
Adɑmɑ nɛ, nɑ nun wɑ̃ɑ yee ɡeeru bɑniɑ,
mi kɑɑ n wɑ̃ɑ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.

content: Sɑlomɔɔn ɡɑri
yi u Isirelibɑ sɔ̃ɔwɑ
Yerɑ sinɑ boko Sɑlomɔɔ u sĩirɑ Isirelibɑ kpuron mi ɡiɑ mi bɑ yɔ̃. Mɑ u bu domɑru kuɑ.
U ɡeruɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ Gusunɔ Isirelibɑn Yinni siɑrɑ, domi u win nɔɔ mwɛɛru yibiɑ te u Dɑfidi nɛn tundo kuɑ u nɛɛ,
sɑɑ mìn di u win tɔmbu Isirelibɑ yɑrɑmɑ Eɡibitin di, u ǹ wuu ɡɑɡu ɡɔsɑ ben wusu ɡɑsu sɔɔ bu kɑ diru bɑni mi bɑ koo nùn sɑ̃. Adɑmɑ Dɑfidiwɑ u ɡɔsɑ u n kɑ sɑ̃ɑ ben kpɑro.
Nɛn tundo Dɑfidi wi, u rɑɑ ɡɔ̃ru doke u Gusunɔ bɛsɛn Yinni diru bɑniɑ.
Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, yɑ wɑ̃ ye u ɡɔ̃ru doke u kɑ nùn diru bɑniɑ.
Adɑmɑ n ǹ wi, u koo nùn tu bɑniɑ. Win bii wi u koo mɑ wiyɑ u koo tu bɑni.
Tɛ̃ Yinni Gusunɔ u win nɔɔ mwɛɛ te yibiɑ. Wee nɛ Sɑlomɔɔ nɑ sinɑ bɛsɛ Isirelibɑn sinɑ ɡɔnɑ wɔllɔ, nɑ nɛn tundo Dɑfidi kɔsire kuɑ. Yen biru nɑ Gusunɔ bɛsɛn Yinni dii te bɑniɑ mi bɑ ko n dɑ nùn sɑ̃.
Dii te sɔɔrɑ nɑ win woodɑn kpɑkororu wɑ̃ɑ yeru kuɑ. Kpee bɛsi yiruwɑ yi wɑ̃ɑ kpɑkoro te sɔɔ, yì sɔɔ bɑ win woodɑbɑ yoruɑ, ye u bɛsɛn bɑɑbɑbɑ wɛ̃ sɑnɑm mɛ u bu yɑrɑmɑ Eɡibitin di.
Sɑlomɔɔn kɑnɑru
Yerɑ Sɑlomɔɔ u yɔ̃rɑ turɑ tèn mi bɑ rɑ yɑ̃kunu kon wuswɑɑɔ Isirelibɑn nɔni biru, mɑ u nɔmɑ suɑ wɔllɔ u kɑnɑru kuɑ.
U nɛɛ, Gusunɔ bɛsɛ Isirelibɑn Yinni, ɡoo mɑɑ sɑri nɡe wunɛ wɔllɔ kɑ temɔ. Wunɛn bwɑ̃ɑ be bɑ nun mɛm nɔɔwɑmmɛ kɑ ɡɔ̃ru tiɑ, ɑ rɑ ɑrukɑwɑni ye ɑ kɑ bu bɔkuɑ yibie kpɑ ɑ bu wunɛn wɔnwɔndu sɔ̃ɔsi.
Wee ɑ wunɛn nɔɔ mwɛɛru yibiɑ te ɑ wunɛn bɔ̃ɔ Dɑfidi nɛn tundo kuɑ. Ye ɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ kpuro, ɑ ye kuɑ ɡisɔ, kɑ wunɛn dɑm.

Yen sɔ̃, Gusunɔ bɛsɛn Yinni, ɑ nɔɔ mwɛɛ te yibio te ɑ nùn kuɑ mi, ɑ nɛɛ, u ǹ kɔsire biɑmɔ win bibun bweseru sɔɔ wi u koo win bɑndu di, bii be, bɑ̀ n tii nɛni dee dee ben wɑ̃ɑru sɔɔ, mɑ bɑ nun mɛm nɔɔwɑmmɛ nɡe mɛ wi, Dɑfidi u kuɑ.
Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, Gusunɔ bɛsɛn Yinni, ɑ de wunɛn ɡɑri yi ɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ mi kpuro, yi koorɑ.
Adɑmɑ kɑɑ sere kpĩ ɑ sinɑ tem mɛ sɔɔ kɑ ɡem? Domi wɔllɑ kun nun turɑ. Kɑɑ sere ɡere dii te nɑ nun bɑniɑ mini?
Kɑ mɛ, Gusunɔ nɛn Yinni, ɑ nɛn ɡere swɑɑ dɑkio kpɑ ɑ nɛn kɑnɑru nɔ te nɑ mɔ̀ ɡisɔ.
A de wunɛn nɔni yi n wɑ̃ɑ dii te sɔɔ wɔ̃kuru kɑ sɔ̃ɔ sɔɔ. A nɛn kɑnɑru swɑɑ dɑkio te nɑ mɔ̀ yɑm mini, domi miyɑ ɑ nɛɛ, kɑɑ tii sɔ̃ɔsi.
Nɛ kɑ wunɛn tɔmbu sɑ̀ n mɛnnɑmɑ yɑm mini, sɑ kɑnɑru mɔ̀, ɑ sun swɑɑ dɑkio, sɑɑ wɔllu di mi ɑ wɑ̃ɑ kpɑ ɑ sun suuru kuɑ.
Goo ù n win winsim torɑri, mɑ bɑ yɛ̃ro tilɑsi kuɑ, u kɑ nɑ mini u bɔ̃re yɑ̃ku yerɔ,
nɑ nun kɑnɑmɔ, ɑ nùn swɑɑ dɑkio wɔllun di, kpɑ ɑ bu siriɑ. A tɔn kɔ̃so nùn win kɔ̃sɑ kɔsieyo, kpɑ ɑ mɑɑ ɡemɡii nùn win ɡem wɛ̃.
Yibɛrɛbɑ bɑ̀ n wunɛn tɔmbu Isirelibɑ kɑmiɑ yèn sɔ̃ bɑ nun torɑri, mɑ bɑ ɡɔ̃ru ɡɔsiɑ bɑ nɑ bɑ nun suuru kɑnɑmɔ dii teni sɔɔ,
ɑ bu swɑɑ dɑkio sɑɑ wɔllun di kpɑ ɑ bu ben durum suuru kuɑ. Kpɑ ɑ de be bɑ yoru mwɛɛrɑ bu wurɑmɑ tem mɛ sɔɔ, mɛ ɑ rɑɑ ben bɑɑbɑbɑ wɛ̃.
À n derɑ ɡurɑ yɑ yɔ̃rɑ yèn sɔ̃ bɑ nun torɑri, mɑ bɑ ɡɔ̃ru ɡɔsiɑ yèn sɔ̃ ɑ bu sekuru doke, mɑ bɑ mɛɛrimɑ yɑm mini, bɑ nun sɑ̃ɑmɔ bɑ kɑnɑru mɔ̀,
ɑ bu swɑɑ dɑkio sɑɑ wɔllun di, kpɑ ɑ bu ben durum suuru kuɑ. A bu swɑɑ ɡeɑ sɔ̃ɔsio yè sɔɔ bɑ koo sĩ, kpɑ ɑ de ɡurɑ yu nɛ tem mɛ sɔɔ, mɛ bɛsɛ wunɛn tɔmbu sɑ tubi di mi.

Gɔ̃ɔru tɑ̀ n duɑ tem mɛ sɔɔ, ǹ kun mɛ kɛ̃si kɛ̃si bɑrɑru, ǹ kun mɛ dĩɑnun ɡɔɔ, ǹ kun mɛ twee, ǹ kun mɛ kɔkɔnu ɡɑnu ni nu rɑ dĩɑnu sɑnku, ǹ kun mɛ yibɛrɛbɑ bɑ̀ n tem mɛn wusu tɑrusi, ǹ kun mɛ bɑrɑ bwese bwesekɑ yɑ̀ n wunɛn tɔmbu deemɑ, ǹ kun mɛ wɑhɑlɑ ɡɑɑ,
bɑ̀ n seewɑ bɑ kɑnɑru mɔ̀, mɑ ben bɑɑwure u win torɑru wurɑ win ɡɔ̃ruɔ, mɑ u win nɔmɑ suemɑ dii tenin berɑ ɡiɑ,
ɑ bu swɑɑ dɑkio sɑɑ wɔllun di mi ɑ wɑ̃ɑ, kpɑ ɑ bu suuru kuɑ, ɑ bɑɑwure kuɑ nɡe mɛ u sɑ̃ɑ. Domi wunɛ turowɑ ɑ tɔnun ɡɔ̃ru yɛ̃.
Kpɑ bu nun nɑsiɑ ben wɑ̃ɑru kpuro sɔɔ tem mɛ sɔɔ, mɛ ɑ ben bɑɑbɑbɑ wɛ̃.
Tɔn tuko ɡoo ù n nɑ u kɑ nun sɑ̃ yèn sɔ̃ u nuɑ wunɛn yĩsirɑ kpɑ̃, mɑ ɑ dɑm bɑkɑm mɔ, mɑ yɛ̃ro u kɑnɑru mɔ̀ dii te sɔɔ,

ɑ nùn swɑɑ dɑkio sɑɑ wɔllun di mi ɑ wɑ̃ɑ, kpɑ ɑ nùn kuɑ ye u nun bikiɑmɔ kpɑ hɑnduniɑn tɔmbu kpuro bu nun ɡiɑ kpɑ bu nun nɑsiɑ, nɡe mɛ wunɛn tɔmbu Isirelibɑ bɑ nun nɑsie, kpɑ bɑ n yɛ̃ mɑ wunɑ bɑ rɑ sɑ̃ dii te sɔɔ, te nɑ bɑnɑ mini.
À n wunɛn tɔmbu Isirelibɑ woodɑ wɛ̃ bu dɑ bu ben yibɛrɛbɑ tɑbu wɔri, mɑ bɑ kɑnɑru koosimɑ wunɛn mi, bɑ mɛɛrimɑ wuu ɡe ɑ ɡɔsɑ kɑ dii te nɑ nun bɑniɑn berɑ ɡiɑ,
ɑ ben kɑnɑru swɑɑ dɑkio wɔllun di kpɑ ɑ bu nɑsɑrɑ wɛ̃.
Bɑ̀ n dɑɑ mɑɑ nun torɑri, domi ɡoo sɑri wi u ku rɑ tore, mɑ wunɛn mɔru yɑ seewɑ ɑ bu yibɛrɛbɑ nɔmu sɔndiɑ, mɑ bɑ bu mwɛɛrɑ bɑ kɑ dɑ, bɑ yoru dimɔ turuku ǹ kun mɛ, mi n tomɑ,

bɑ̀ n bwisikɑ tem mi bɑ yoru dimɔ mi, mɑ bɑ ɡɔ̃ru ɡɔsiɑ mɑm mɑm, bɑ nun tii wɛ̃ mɑ bɑ tem mɛni mɛɛrimɑ mɛ ɑ ben bɑɑbɑbɑ wɛ̃, kɑ wuu ɡeni, ɡe ɑ ɡɔsɑ kɑ sɑ̃ɑ yee te nɑ nun bɑniɑ mini, bɑ̀ n kɑnɑru mɔ̀, bɑ mɔ̀, bɑ nun torɑri bɑ durum kuɑ,
ɑ bu swɑɑ dɑkio wunɛn wɑ̃ɑ yerun di kpɑ ɑ bu kuɑ ye n weenɛ.
A bu ben durum kɑ ben torɑnu kpuro suuru kuo, kpɑ ɑ de be bɑ bu yoru diisiɑmɔ bu ben wɔnwɔndu wɑ.
Domi bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ wunɛn tɔmbu be ɑ yɑrɑmɑ Eɡibitin di mi bɑ nɔni sɔ̃ɔrɑ.
A de ɑ nɛ kɑ wunɛn tɔmbu kpuro durom kuɑ kpɑ ɑ bɛsɛn nɔɔ nɔ, sɑɑ ye sɑ nun kɑnɑmɔ kpuro.
Domi wunɑ ɑ sun ɡɔsɑ bwese ni nu tien suunu sɔɔn di. Mɑ ɑ sun kuɑ wunɛɡibu nɡe mɛ ɑ ɡeruɑ, sɑɑ wunɛn sɔm kowo Mɔwisin nɔɔn di, sɑnɑm mɛ ɑ bɛsɛn bɑɑbɑbɑ yɑrɑmɑ Eɡibitin di.
Sɑlomɔɔn kɑnɑ dɑ̃ɑkiru
Sɑɑ ye Sɑlomɔɔ u win kɑnɑ te kuɑ u kpɑ, yerɑ u seewɑ u yɔ̃rɑ yɑ̃ku yeru mi, mi u rɑɑ yiire u nɔmɑ sue wɔllɔ.
Mi u yɔ̃ mi, u nɔɔɡiru suɑ min di, kɑ dɑm u Isireli be bɑ mɛnnɛ mi domɑru kuɑ u nɛɛ,
nɑ Yinni Gusunɔ siɑrɑ wi u win tɔmbu bɔri yɛndu wɛ̃ nɡe mɛ u rɑɑ ɡeruɑ. Nɔɔ mwɛɛ duro ni u rɑɑ kuɑ sɑɑ win sɔm kowo Mɔwisin min di, nin ɡɑrɑ kun kɑm kue.
Yen sɔ̃, nɑ kɑnɑmɔ u n mɑɑ kɑ sun wɑ̃ɑ nɡe mɛ u rɑɑ kɑ bɛsɛn bɑɑbɑbɑ wɑ̃ɑ, u ku sun duɑri, u ku mɑɑ sun deri.
U bɛsɛn bwɛ̃rɑ ɡɔsio win mi ɡiɑ kpɑ su kpĩ su win swɛɛ kpuro swĩi su win woodɑbɑ kɑ win yiirebu kpuro mɛm nɔɔwɑ bi u bɛsɛn bɑɑbɑbɑ wɛ̃.
Kɑnɑ te nɑ kuɑ win wuswɑɑɔ mini, u tu mɔɔ kpɑ u n tu yɑɑye bɑɑdommɑ, kpɑ u n dɑ nɛ kɑ win tɔmbu Isirelibɑ ɡeɑ kue.
Nɡe mɛyɑ hɑnduniɑn bwesenu kpuro nu koo kɑ ɡiɑ mɑ wi turowɑ u sɑ̃ɑ Gusunɔ. Goo mɑɑ sɑri nɡe wi.
Yen sɔ̃, bɛɛ win tɔmbu, i bɛɛn ɡɔ̃rusu nùn wɛ̃ɛyɔ mɑm mɑm. Kpɑ i kpĩ i win yiirebu kɑ win woodɑbɑ mɛm nɔɔwɑ.
Bɑ yɑ̃ku kobu toruɑ
Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ
Yen biru Sɑlomɔɔ sinɑ boko kɑ Isirelibɑ kpuro bɑ mɛnnɑ bɑ Yinni Gusunɔ yɑ̃kunu kuɑ.
Sɑlomɔɔ u kɛtɛ nɔrɔbun subɑ yɛndɑ yiru (22.000) kɑ yɑ̃ɑnu nɔrɔbun subɑ wunɑɑ teeru (120.000) ɡo u kɑ siɑrɑbun yɑ̃kunu kuɑ. Mɛyɑ bɑ kɑ Yinni Gusunɔ sɑ̃ɑ yee te wukiɑ.

Yen dɔmɑ te, Sɑlomɔɔ u derɑ bɑ sɑ̃ɑ yee ten yɑɑrɑn suunu ɡɔsɑ bɑ dɛɛrɑsiɑ. Mɑ bɑ yɑ̃kunu kuɑ mi, domi yɑ̃ku yerun turɑ te bɑ kuɑ kɑ sii ɡɑndu tɑ ǹ kpɛ̃ tu yɑ̃ku dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑruɡii ni mwɑ kɑ dĩɑ ni bɑ Yinni Gusunɔ kɑ̃ mi, kɑ sere siɑrɑbun yɑ̃kunun yɑɑ ɡum.

Bɑ sɑ̃ɑ yee ten wukiɑbun tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑru diwɑ sɔ̃ɔ nɔɔbɑ yiru. Yen biruwɑ bɑ mɑɑ Kunun tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑru di. Tɔn dɑbirɑ nɑwɑ tem mɛn bɑɑmɑn di sɑɑ Hɑmɑtin di n kɑ ɡirɑri Eɡibitin dɑɑrun berɑ ɡiɑ. Mɑ bɑ mɛnnɑ Yinni Gusunɔn wuswɑɑɔ siki siki. Bɑ tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑ te diwɑ sɔ̃ɔ nɔɔbɑ yiru.

Sɔ̃ɔ nɔɔbɑ itɑse, yerɑ Sɑlomɔɔ u ben bɑɑwure kɑrɑ, mɑ bɑ nùn domɑru kuɑ. Yen biru bɑ sĩɑ ben yɛnusɔ kɑ nuku dobu kɑ bɔri yɛndu, durom mɛ Yinni Gusunɔ u win bɔ̃ɔ Dɑfidi kɑ win tɔmbu Isirelibɑ kuɑn sɔ̃.
